orgs.name: CERN (European Org for Nuclear Research)
orgs.desc: CERN is the European laboratory for particle physics, operating the Large Hadron Collider and creating foundational open-source scientific analysis software.

orgs.name: CNES / CS Group (Orekit)
orgs.desc: Orekit is an accurate, efficient, and open-source low-level space flight dynamics library used by space agencies and satellite operators worldwide.

orgs.name: EuroOSS Applied AI & Ethics Research Hub
orgs.desc: EuroOSS is the collaborative European laboratory for trustworthy open-source software, ethical AI metrics, and EU AI Act compliance tools.

orgs.name: European Space Agency (ESA ACT)
orgs.desc: The Advanced Concepts Team (ACT) is the European Space Agency research group exploring futuristic space technologies, orbital mechanics, and bio-inspired AI.

orgs.name: Libre Space Foundation
orgs.desc: Libre Space Foundation develops open-source hardware and software space technologies including the SatNOGS global satellite tracking network.

orgs.name: Stellarium Astronomy Project
orgs.desc: Stellarium is an open-source planetarium that shows a realistic 3D sky in real time with constellations, planets, and deep-sky objects.

orgs.name: Airbus Defence and Space Open Lab
orgs.desc: Airbus Defence and Space open-sources satellite constellation power simulators and space telemetry data models for European aerospace engineers.

orgs.name: ASTRON (Netherlands Institute for Radio Astronomy)
orgs.desc: ASTRON operates the LOFAR telescope and coordinates international radio astronomy arrays, developing open signal processing and RFI mitigation engines.

orgs.name: Astropy European Project
orgs.desc: The Astropy Project is a community effort to develop a single core package for astronomy in Python and foster interoperability between astronomy packages.

orgs.name: CEA (French Atomic & Alternative Energy Commission)
orgs.desc: CEA is a French major research organization in energy, defense, and space astrophysics, maintaining the open Salomé scientific simulation platform.

orgs.name: ESA Copernicus Earth Observation (SNAP)
orgs.desc: The Copernicus Earth Observation programme operates the Sentinel satellite constellation, developing the open-source Sentinel Application Platform (SNAP).

orgs.name: ESA ESOC Mission Operations
orgs.desc: ESA European Space Operations Centre (ESOC) in Darmstadt manages satellite flight control, ground station communication networks, and the EGS-CC spacecraft telemetry system.

orgs.name: EUMETSAT Weather & Climate Earth Observation
orgs.desc: EUMETSAT operates European meteorological satellites, developing Satpy, pyresample, and open climate telemetry processing engines.

orgs.name: European Southern Observatory (ESO)
orgs.desc: ESO operates the world most advanced ground-based astronomical telescopes including the Very Large Telescope (VLT) and ALMA in the Atacama desert.

orgs.name: European Synchrotron Radiation Facility (ESRF)
orgs.desc: ESRF operates the most intense synchrotron radiation source in Europe, open-sourcing Silx and PyMca for real-time 3D X-ray micro-tomography.

orgs.name: Fraunhofer Society Open Space & IoT
orgs.desc: Fraunhofer is Europe largest application-oriented research organization, authoring the FROST-Server for OGC SensorThings spatial telemetry.

orgs.name: German Aerospace Center (DLR SUMO)
orgs.desc: DLR is Germany national research center for aerospace and transport, authoring SUMO (Simulation of Urban Mobility) used globally for traffic simulations.

orgs.name: INAF (Italian National Institute for Astrophysics)
orgs.desc: INAF coordinates astronomical research in Italy across 20 research facilities, authoring open scientific data visualization tools for high-energy space missions.

orgs.name: IRAP (Astrophysics & Planetology Research Inst - Toulouse)
orgs.desc: IRAP is the French laboratory for planetology and astrophysics in Toulouse, creating the AMDA Automated Multi-Dataset Analysis space plasma tool.

orgs.name: Max Planck Institute for Astronomy (MPIA)
orgs.desc: Max Planck Institute for Astronomy conducts leading observational and theoretical astrophysical research on planet formation and stellar physics.

orgs.name: ONERA (French Aerospace Lab)
orgs.desc: ONERA is the French national aerospace research laboratory conducting cutting-edge aeronautical fluid dynamics and spacecraft aerodynamics research.

orgs.name: Open Cosmos Space Missions
orgs.desc: Open Cosmos manufactures and flies modular Earth Observation satellite constellations, providing open telemetry tools for nanosatellites.

orgs.name: OpenSpace Astro-Visualizer
orgs.desc: OpenSpace is an open-source interactive data visualization software designed to visualize the entire known universe and space missions in real-time.

orgs.name: Royal Observatory of Belgium (STCE / ROB)
orgs.desc: The Solar-Terrestrial Centre of Excellence (STCE) at the Royal Observatory of Belgium provides European space weather forecasting and solar activity monitoring.

orgs.name: SRON (Netherlands Institute for Space Research)
orgs.desc: SRON develops cutting-edge space instruments for astrophysics and Earth observation missions including SPEXone on NASA PACE and XMM-Newton.

orgs.name: Vertex Applied AI Hub
orgs.desc: Vertex Applied AI Hub develops frameworks for open-science AI applications, emphasizing compliance with modern ethics standards and the EU AI Act.
